previous_statement: Let h_n=(Ha^Q_{P,P})_n and a_n=inf_{Z nonzero} ||h_n(Z)||/||Z||. For e below the adjointness, product-defect, and square-estimate thresholds, lem-hcb2-amplified-adjointness and lem-hcb2-product-defect imply a_n^2 >= (1-K_sq e)a_n-C_prod e for every n.
new_statement: Conditional recurrence at a fixed amplification: fix n>=1 with M_n tensor S_P nonzero, put h_n=(Ha^Q_{P,P})_n and a_n=inf_{Z nonzero} ||h_n(Z)||/||Z||, and assume the square lower bound ||Z^dagger dot Z|| >= (1-K_sq e)||Z||^2 for every Z in M_n tensor S_P. Then, for e below the amplified-adjointness and product-defect thresholds, lem-hcb2-amplified-adjointness and lem-hcb2-product-defect imply a_n^2 >= (1-K_sq e)a_n-C_prod e. The allowed inputs do not themselves establish the square lower bound uniformly in n, so this node does not assert the unconditional all-n recurrence.
